videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Minnesota Golden Gophers (5-5) host the Northwestern Wildcats (6-4) at Huntington Bank Stadium in a Big Ten game. Both sides aim to break a three-game skid. Northwestern lost against Ohio State 28-19, while Minnesota fell to Penn State 42-14.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Big Ten action continues as Rutgers (2-8, 1-6) takes on Penn State (6-4, 3-4) at Beaver Stadium. Rutgers seeks to end a four-game skid after a 31-0 shutout loss to Nebraska, while Penn State seeks to make it four straight wins behind Rocco Becht.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Kansas State Wildcats (4-6) host the No. 19 Arizona Wildcats (7-3) at Bill Snyder Family Stadium in a Big 12 Conference game. Kansas State aims to break a four-game losing streak, while Arizona has an alternate win-loss record in their last four.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Nevada Wolf Pack (4-6, 3-3 Mountain West) face the Hawaii Rainbow Warriors (3-7, 2-5). Nevada enters after snapping a two-game skid by beating Northern Illinois 28-7. Hawaii fell 21-13 to North Dakota State and relies on Micah Alejado.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The No. 14 Buckeyes (7-3, 5-2 Big Ten) face the Cornhuskers (6-4, 3-4) at Memorial Stadium. Ohio State enters after a 28-19 victory against Northwestern behind Luke Fahey, while Nebraska snapped a skid and beat Rutgers for a shutout 31-0 win.

videos.title: College Basketball
videos.description: The No. 18 Michigan Wolverines face the Villanova Wildcats in an NCAA Division I Men's game. Michigan rides a two-game win streak with Trey McKenney, while Villanova lost 81-61 to Pittsburgh on Nov. 17 with Devin Royal in non-conference play.
